name: Ledger
subtitle: Ledger business simulation builds
description: Unsigned builds of the Ledger business simulation. AltStore signs them with your own Apple ID. The list is filled in by the IPA workflow after each successful build.

versions.localizedDescription:
# What's new
- Own delivery books the delivery fee customers pay; type a price in any item page; franchise applications show their four steps
- Home suggestions open the section that needs you; your badge shows on company cards; managers hire remote roles even when the office is full
- Week report: Continue and Full report stay pinned at the bottom of the card
- Balance: ads now stack on your name and show payback; second-store readiness; known brands resist rivals; skilled play out-earns idle play
- Accounting: balance sheet and cash flow; choose your accountant (Atlas, new company, conversion); people cost and pay day panels
- Inbox: "Handled by" and a Handled tab; messages open the right app; research reports open as documents
- Group: "Who runs what" table; own staff on a board; interview chips for manager candidates
- Goals link to where they are done; promises can be given more time
- Operations: repair at your own garage, add retail catalogue items, analyst and ranking in Market
- News links to the company; achievements show streaks; reports show more figures
- Hiring: mobile and remote roles no longer need a desk; checklist always completable; picker shows affordable trades

# What's new
- Remove people from a board (vote if you hold 50% or less; notice paid to outside directors)
- Portraits for managers, executives, board members; Inbox shows faces
- Home companies list is its own scrollable box
- Chain manager appoints regional managers; regional managers hire each store's manager; owner can approve or decline
- Open posts: search and hire from the Management tab, shows who hires and with what authority
- Market no longer sends "you bought" notices for cars a hired buyer bought

# Missing / coming next
- Own-delivery fee, typed prices per trade, chain/franchise steps, more photos
- Not yet tested on device: expect rough edges

# What's new
- Market: no more "you bought" notices for cars a hired buyer or manager bought; one quiet weekly note instead
- Profit today counts what you did between days (e.g. a new store in a chain)
- Popups: one overlay host and one text rule set

# Missing / coming next
- Board removal, manager pictures, scrollable companies box, chain/regional manager hiring in progress
